Apple AudioUnitSDK 1.4.0, upstream commit bd98b31feff57a15989fcfab4cd86dc63382b1ac.
Source: https://github.com/apple/AudioUnitSDK (retrieved 2026-10-24 JST).
include/, src/, LICENSE.txt (AUUtility.h trailing whitespace removed; no semantic changes); Apache-2.0. Only this open-source SDK is included.

No commercial AU, Apple instrument, preset, Logic project or authorization material included.
